title: Automatic build-time plugin composition foundation
description: Extend the existing signup plugin protocol: validated enabled configuration and dependencies, collision-safe native TypeScript schema/resources, matching frontend components sharing API types, deterministic normal-build preparation, no-plugin parity, minimal proof and authorization tests. Record decisions, review, checks and draft PR; no deployment or CRM implementation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Present state inspected: origin/develop 1138a61 includes M9 signup plugin PR #201 (a85ddb2). Native Gen 2 plugin schema/functions/wiring already exist, but blind merges permit collisions, Schema type drops plugin definitions, frontend panel/script wiring is manual, and Python static asset catalog duplicates TS manifests. Implement by extending this protocol: deterministic config/dependency/collision checks, exact native types, generated metadata plus lazy newsroom panel registration, automatic static scripts/public runtime context, opt-in private two-model/two-component proof. Markus 0.5.1 CLI and in-process paths do not share custom directives; no directive change needed. Tracking commit b070aea pushed to feature/PPY-f8bbd3-plugin-build-foundation. Auto-review denied direct develop tracking push; safer isolated-branch delivery succeeded. No resources deployed; existing main checkout untouched.

comments.author: home
comments.text: CANCELED by Ryan on 2026-10-13: "take back that initiative about creating plugins into Papyrus, cuz I think we just eliminated that entire problem". Prospectus can use existing Kanbus/Virtuus issue storage as a separate application/subdomain with simple configured links/intake; the proposed plugin foundation is therefore no longer needed. All implementation agents stopped immediately. This is cancellation, not completed delivery. Partial work is preserved in the isolated feature/PPY-f8bbd3-plugin-build-foundation worktree and a local archive; no implementation was merged or deployed. No alternative CRM or baseline tables are being implemented. Supersedes this issue and its initiative plan.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Archive note 2026-10-20: initiative PPY-fabbf7 is cancelled, so this stays closed. The 32 uncommitted files in the Codex checkout (feature/PPY-f8bbd3-plugin-build-foundation, upstream deleted) were NOT pushed as an archive branch: the repo's gitleaks pre-commit/push check blocks them (personal-email and session-uuid test fixtures in plugin signup/projection/prepare-plugins files). They are preserved outside git at ~/Projects/.baselines/papyrus-plugin-wip-f8bbd3-tracked-20261020.patch (11 modified files) and papyrus-plugin-wip-f8bbd3-untracked-20261020.tgz (23 new files); the Codex checkout is untouched. Pushing an archive branch needs the fixtures sanitised first.

right_now_summary: The plugin foundation was canceled, and no implementation was merged or deployed.
